name: Transfer Certificate
html:
{{ oc_reissue_mark(doc) }}

{{ doc.company }}

{{ _("Transfer Certificate") }}

{{ _("No.") }} {{ doc.certificate_number }}
{{ _("Date") }}: {{ frappe.format(doc.issued_on, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) if doc.issued_on else "" }}

{% set dob = frappe.db.get_value("Student", doc.student, "date_of_birth") %}
{{ _("Name of student") }}{{ doc.student_name }}
{{ _("Student ID") }}{{ doc.student }}
{{ _("Date of birth") }}{{ frappe.format(dob, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) if dob else "" }}
{{ _("Date of leaving") }}{{ frappe.format(doc.leaving_date, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) if doc.leaving_date else "" }}
{{ _("Reason for leaving") }}{{ doc.reason_for_leaving }}
{{ _("Conduct") }}{{ _("Good") }}
{{ _("Purpose") }}{{ doc.purpose }}

{{ _("The student has paid all dues to the institution and its trust.") }}

{{ _("Principal") }}

{{ oc_qr_block(doc) }}
